name: Processor D - cycle with opposite couplers
justification: The Phase 1 ring-ansatz study measured five routing SWAPs on Processor A and none on B. For Phase 2 PS-S1, the HVA ZZ terms compiled in the CX-only A/B basis require two CX gates per logical ZZ rotation. D retains the measured four-qubit cycle, supports the optional N=6 open chain, and uses native RZZ so each HVA ZZ rotation is one two-qubit gate without routing. We assign RZZ the official CX error rate, not a better one. The nine-coupler design costs more calibration and may expose crosstalk that this depolarizing model omits.
